name: Davor Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah
role: Target acquisition and fugitive recovery — bounty hunter
location: Crucible Square — open-air market, Tier 1-2 commerce, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Davor Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah is athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in GLMZ, the distinction is academic. At 36, her face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and she has learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — bioware adrenaline regulator — keeps calm under fire, controlled hormone release — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Born and raised in GLMZ, third generation — she has the city in her blood, its rhythms in her bones, its cruelty in her expectations. She works as a bounty hunter out of Crucible Square, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

she is not the most talented bounty hunter in GLMZ, but she might be the most stubborn, and in this city that's worth more.

core_fears: Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
coping_mechanisms: Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
blind_spots: Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
psychology.secret: Davor Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah is addicted to combat stims. Functions fine on them, can't function without them. The dependency is invisible to everyone except their street doc.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Multilingual fragments — switches languages mid-thought, not for privacy but because some concepts only fit in specific tongues.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
example_lines: "Everyone has a pattern. Patterns are addresses waiting to be read."
"I find people. Whether they're alive when I bring them back depends on their behavior."
"You can run. It's cardiovascular exercise for both of us."

story_hooks: Someone is impersonating Davor Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Davor Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah owes a personal debt to
A crew member from Davor Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
narrative_function: Davor Hedberg-Owusu-Ansah represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Bioware adrenaline regulator — keeps calm under fire, controlled hormone release. Reflex boosters wired into spinal column — shaves reaction time by 40ms
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Claims to live in the present but is haunted by specific moments from the past that dictate current behavior
habits: Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
breaking_points: Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown
Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized

physical_description.build: Athletic and lean with defined musculature — swimmer's shoulders, runner's legs. No excess weight. The body of someone who trains daily and treats their frame as a tool.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural reddish undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, practical braid. Styled for function, not aesthetics.
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown — warm undertone from West African heritage, with slight pallor suggesting irregular sunlight exposure
physical_description.complexion: Sharp facial structure with high cheekbones and a strong jaw. Minimal grooming beyond the practical — no makeup, well-maintained scar tissue around left eyebrow. Skin shows the wear of someone who spends time outdoors and doesn't prioritize cosmetic upkeep.
distinguishing_marks: Thin scar running from left temple to cheekbone — approximately 8cm, likely from a blade or broken glass, healed without professional correction
Burn mark on right inner forearm — roughly 4cm diameter, circular, consistent with contact burn from industrial equipment or old bioware calibration scar
Tattoo on left wrist: small geometric pattern in black ink, GLMZ street runner's mark indicating affiliation cohort
Knuckle scars on both hands — boxer's damage from years of unarmed combat training
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioware adrenaline regulator visible as a slight subdermal ridge along the left side of her neck, pale scar tissue where the unit interfaces with her nervous system. A secondary port glints under the jaw at certain angles — reflex booster spinal interface, visible as a thin metallic line running down the back of her neck when her braid shifts. Both augmentations show signs of field maintenance and recalibration.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight distributed between both feet, never fully relaxed. Movement is economical and fluid — dancer-like footwork combined with fighter's awareness. Eyes track everything in her visual field. Resting face is neutral, almost flat affect, but the micro-expressions suggest constant threat assessment. Walks like someone who expects trouble at any moment and has trained to respond in under half a second.
physical_description.clothing_style: Practical Tier 3-4 runner's uniform: matte black tactical jacket with internal webbing for equipment, reinforced at stress points. Underneath, a fitted gray shirt treated for stain and damage resistance. Black cargo pants with utility pockets and concealed thigh holster. Worn boots with good traction and ankle support — scuffed, maintained but not replaced until necessary. One piece of jewelry: a silver chain bracelet with a flat credit token. No logos, no flash. Everything chosen for function. Overall aesthetic is 'someone you don't want to meet in an alley' — not because of style, but because of how the clothes hang on the frame and the scars visible at the wrists and neck.
